channel.title: Homeowners of Texas — Homeowner Watch
channel.description: Automatically refreshed Texas homeowner data and legislative activity.

item.title: HB 105 Introduced
item.description: Relating to the transport of female patients to a mental health facility or residential care facility.

item.title: HB 111 Introduced
item.description: Relating to a prohibition on the installation or construction of border security infrastructure on state park property.

item.title: HB 128 Introduced
item.description: Relating to disclosures required to record certain contracts for the conveyance of real property.

item.title: HB 137 Introduced
item.description: Relating to employment practices of governmental entities, state and local contractors, and private employers in this state regarding the legal status of employees, including requiring participation in the federal electronic verification of employment authorization program, or E-verify program, and authorizing the suspension of certain licenses held by private employers for certain conduct in relation to the employment of persons not lawfully present.

item.title: HB 139 Introduced
item.description: Relating to maximum nonfuel rates certain electric utilities may charge residential retail customers.

item.title: HB 169 Introduced
item.description: Relating to participation of political subdivisions and contractors and subcontractors of political subdivisions in the federal electronic verification of employment authorization program, or E-verify.

item.title: HB 216 Introduced
item.description: Relating to establishment of the disaster identification system for a declared state of disaster.

item.title: HB 226 Introduced
item.description: Relating to rates for residential property insurance and personal automobile insurance.

item.title: HB 270 Introduced
item.description: Relating to the use of state money for high-speed rail operated by a private entity and to the construction of certain high-speed rail.

item.title: HB 281 Introduced
item.description: Relating to the regulation of residential treatment centers, including requirements related to public education for certain children who reside in residential treatment centers; creating a criminal offense.

item.title: HB 311 Introduced
item.description: Relating to the authority of the legislature, governor, and certain political subdivisions with respect to disasters and emergencies.

item.title: HB 313 Introduced
item.description: Relating to prohibiting state agencies from adopting, enforcing, or maintaining a rule requiring certain applicants to the agency to provide proof of citizenship or residency in the United States.

item.title: HB 332 Introduced
item.description: Relating to the allocation and deposit of certain surplus state revenue to the property tax relief fund for use in reducing school district maintenance and operations ad valorem taxes.

item.title: HB 336 Introduced
item.description: Relating to requiring a seller of residential property or unimproved real property to be used for residential purposes to disclose an oil, gas, or mineral lease on the property and oil and gas equipment on the property or adjoining property.

item.title: HB 356 Introduced
item.description: Relating to the authority of certain counties to regulate noise levels in residential areas; creating a criminal offense.

item.title: HB 373 Introduced
item.description: Relating to the issuance of specialty license plates for members of the United States Naval Construction Battalions.

item.title: HB 393 Introduced
item.description: Relating to the regulation of residential immigrant detention facilities; requiring a license; authorizing a fee; providing administrative and civil penalties.

item.title: HB 431 Introduced
item.description: Relating to prohibiting oral releases for automobile insurance claims.

item.title: HB 452 Introduced
item.description: Relating to a study by the Texas A&M AgriLife Extension Service to determine standards for the appraisal for ad valorem tax purposes of certain agricultural land used to raise or keep bees.

item.title: HB 456 Introduced
item.description: Relating to the applicability of the law authorizing the county fire marshal in certain counties to inspect certain group homes where residential care services are provided to the residents.
